description: This file defines a ContentProvider named FeedProvider for managing access to a feed database, including routes for entries and entry IDs, implementing basic CRUD operations with SQLite database integration.

classes.name: FeedProvider
classes.description: A ContentProvider implementation that manages access to a SQLite database of feed entries, handling query, insert, delete, and update operations.

classes.name: FeedProvider.FeedDatabase
classes.description: An internal SQLiteOpenHelper class for creating and managing the feed database schema.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the database helper when the provider is created.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type string based on the URI pattern matched.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles query requests by URI, returning Cursor objects for entries or specific entries.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts new entries into the database and notifies observers.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes entries from the database based on URI and selection criteria.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing database entries based on URI and selection.
